_comment: Two identical, aligned H2O molecules (each C2 axis along x, like h2o-single-x.xyz), head-to-tail along x, built by scripts/make_cluster.py. Default separation R = 8.0 A; other separations: --set xyz_file=geometries/h2o_N2_headtail-x_R<R>A.xyz --name R<R>. Cavity tuned to the bend, polarized along x, same as the single molecule. Runs go to runs/h2o_N2/.
